entries.title: Amos 7:7
segments: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall [made] by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

entries.title: Amos 7:8
segments: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

entries.title: Amos 7:9
segments: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

entries.title: Amos 7:10
segments: ¶Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

entries.title: Amos 7:11
segments: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

entries.title: Amos 7:12
segments: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

entries.title: Amos 7:13
segments: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it [is] the king's chapel, and it [is] the king's court. {chapel: or, sanctuary} {king's court: Heb. house of the kingdom}

words.text: . {chapel: or, sanctuary} {king's court: Heb. house of the kingdom}

entries.title: Amos 7:14
segments: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I [was] no prophet, neither [was] I a prophet's son; but I [was] an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit: {sycomore...: or, wild figs}

entries.title: Amos 7:15
segments: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel. {as...: Heb. from behind}

entries.title: Amos 7:16
segments: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not [thy word] against the house of Isaac.

entries.title: Amos 7:17
segments: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
